newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-WEEKEND ENGLISH PREMIER LEAGUE PROGRAMME.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WEEKEND ENGLISH PREMIER LEAGUE PROGRAMME.

text.p: English premier league matches this weekend (league positions in parentheses, all kickoff times GMT)
Henning Berg and Jeff Kenna return for Blackburn who will be without Colin Hendry and Chris Coleman and have a doubt over Kevin Gallacher.
Paul McGrath, who moved from Aston Villa in midweek will make his Derby debut -- against Newcastle's in-form frontline of Alan Shearer and Les Ferdinand.
Everton will be boosted by their first win in eight games against Sheffield Wednesday while West Ham, beaten by Liverpool, will be anxious to avoid a second successive Merseyside loss.
Leeds hope to have Ian Rush and Mark Hateley back with the club's injury crisis beginning to ease but Carlton Palmer is suspended.
Muzzie Izzet, will be hoping to impress against his former club who are looking for their first league win for a month.
Roy Keane out for United but Ronnie Johnsen likely to return against the league leaders who hope that defender Dominic Matteo is fit enought to play.
Tottenham likely to still be without injured striker Chris Armstrong while Villa will miss England international defender Gareth Southgate with an ankle ligament injury. T
Sheffield Wednesday have slipped alarmingly since winning their opening four matches. Signing Inter Milan midfielder Benito Carbone would be a big boost.

Coventry full-back Regis Genaux is out with a groin injury suffered in a reserve match but Southampton manager Graeme Souness is poised to give debuts to recent signings Israeli winger Iyal Berkowic and Norwegian striker Egil Ostenstad.
Both teams will be looking for a win in what will be a passionate north-east derby after defeats at Arsenal and Southampton respectively last time out.
